items.exampleEn: Her poems are full of patriotism and love for the land.
items.exampleZh: 她的詩充滿愛國情懷和對這片土地的愛。

items.exampleEn: Our school holds an evacuation drill twice a year.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校每年舉行兩次疏散演習。

items.exampleEn: The village no longer allows the slaughter of animals in the market.
items.exampleZh: 這個村子不再允許在市場裡屠宰動物。

items.exampleEn: In the old days, people who could not pay their debts were imprisoned.
items.exampleZh: 從前，還不出債務的人會被關進監牢。

items.exampleEn: The new theory overthrew old ideas about the stars.
items.exampleZh: 這個新理論推翻了過去對星星的舊觀念。

items.exampleEn: The sound of a gunshot scared the birds out of the trees.
items.exampleZh: 一聲槍響把鳥從樹上嚇飛了。

items.exampleEn: The alarm went off when an intruder climbed over the garden wall.
items.exampleZh: 有闖入者爬過花園圍牆時，警鈴響了起來。

items.exampleEn: The coach spoke in a calm, authoritative voice.
items.exampleZh: 教練用冷靜而有威信的語氣說話。

items.sentenceEn: The evacuation of the building took less than five minutes.
items.sentenceZh: 這棟大樓的疏散花了不到五分鐘。

items.audioEn: We heard what sounded like a gunshot, but it was only an old car in the street.
items.audioZh: 我們聽到像是槍聲的聲音，但那只是街上的一輛舊車。

items.sentenceEn: Our cat stared angrily at the intruder, a curious dog from next door.
items.sentenceZh: 我們家的貓氣呼呼地瞪著那個不速之客——隔壁一隻好奇的狗。

items.sentenceEn: The meat is checked carefully after slaughter.
items.sentenceZh: 肉品在屠宰後會經過仔細檢查。

items.stemEn: The evil queen decided to ____ the princess in a tall tower.
items.stemZh: 邪惡的皇后決定把公主關在一座高塔裡。

items.stemEn: The fire alarm rang, and the ____ of the office building began at once.
items.stemZh: 火災警報響起，辦公大樓立刻開始疏散。

items.passageEn: Our guide led us through the old castle on the hill. She said that for two hundred years, it was home to a powerful family. In 1650, the family's youngest son tried to overthrow his older brother, but he failed and was imprisoned in the north tower for the rest of his life. The guide also told us that the thick walls were built to stop any intruder, and she showed us a hidden door that only the family knew about. Most of her stories come from an authoritative history of the town. Today, the castle is an important part of the town's heritage.
items.passageZh: 導遊帶我們參觀山丘上的古堡。她說兩百年來，這裡一直是一個有權勢家族的住所。1650 年，家族中最小的兒子企圖推翻他的哥哥，但失敗了，餘生都被關在北塔裡。導遊還告訴我們，厚厚的城牆是為了阻擋任何闖入者而建，並帶我們看一扇只有家族成員知道的密門。她講的故事大多來自一本關於本鎮的權威史書。如今，這座城堡是鎮上重要的文化遺產。

questions.questionZh: 最小的兒子後來怎麼了？
options: 成功取代哥哥成為家主
帶著家人一起搬離城堡

questions.questionZh: 導遊說厚厚的城牆有什麼用途？

items.promptZh: 比賽在一聲槍響後開始。
referenceEn: The race started with a gunshot.
The race began after a gunshot.
rubricZh: 要用 gunshot（例如 a gunshot）
介系詞合理即可（例如 with、after）

items.promptZh: 國際比賽期間，很多球迷揮舞國旗來表達他們的愛國心。
referenceEn: During international games, many fans show their patriotism by waving flags.
Many fans wave flags to show their patriotism during international games.
rubricZh: patriotism 表示「愛國心」（例如 show their patriotism 等）
「揮舞國旗」可寫，例如 waving flags、wave their national flags 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 show、showed 等）
